pages.lesson:
LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 5.1.1 GIVING DIRECTIONS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.1: Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Giving Directions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Giving Directions
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why are directions important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. write words with correct spelling for accuracy
2. construct sentences to give directions for information
3. value correct spelling in written texts for effective communication

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Giving Directions

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Giving Directions

Teach
• Focus skill: write words with correct spelling for accuracy.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Giving Directions.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Giving Directions
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why are directions important?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
